mapper.select: SELECT f.*, b.warehouse_id, w.warehouse_name, w.warehouse_type, w.warehouse_role, b.project_no, b.project_name, b.material_code, b.material_name, b.project_material_sku, b.material_category, b.color, b.model, b.uom, b.packaging_level FROM sku_daily_metric_fact f JOIN warehouse_sku_base b ON b.warehouse_sku_key = f.warehouse_sku_key JOIN warehouse w ON w.warehouse_id = b.warehouse_id b.warehouse_id = #{warehouseId} ORDER BY f.biz_date DESC, b.project_no, b.material_code
